scientific_role: Test whether stock exposure to causal innovations in aggregate equity-market volatility can be represented broadly, stably and distinctly in pre-2021 PIT A-share history before any V37 forward path or payoff is read.
economic_hypothesis: A stock that historically loses more when aggregate market volatility unexpectedly rises is a poor hedge against worsening market uncertainty. If investors require compensation for holding that covariance risk, the most negative aggregate-volatility-innovation exposures may earn higher subsequent long-only returns. This direction is frozen from the risk-compensation mechanism and may not be reversed after results.

novelty_boundary.new_claim: V37 measures a stock's contemporaneous 120-session conditional exposure to changes in already-observed broad-market realized volatility, after controlling for the contemporaneous broad-market return.
novelty_boundary.not_low_idio: Low Idio ranks residual return dispersion. V37 ranks the signed covariance loading on an aggregate volatility innovation; idiosyncratic volatility is only a redundancy control.
novelty_boundary.not_low_vol_of_vol: Low Vol-of-Vol ranks instability of the stock's own realized volatility. V37 uses a common market-volatility innovation and a signed stock-return loading.
novelty_boundary.not_low_skew_or_max: No stock-return skewness, extreme-return maximum or lottery-preference statistic defines the V37 ordering; both are controls.
novelty_boundary.not_market_or_downside_beta: The contemporaneous market return is explicitly controlled in the V37 regression. Ordinary market beta and down-market beta are separate reconstruction controls.
novelty_boundary.not_v36_price_delay: V36 measures incremental explanatory power of lagged weekly market returns. V37 has no lagged-price regressors or delay ratio; exact V36 score is an overlap control where available.
novelty_boundary.not_momentum_reversal_or_chart_shape: No cumulative-return sign, breakout, reversal, support, candle or visual label selects a V37 event. Prior return is only a redundancy control.
novelty_boundary.not_dispersion_alpha: The common state is aggregate realized-volatility innovation, not cross-sectional return dispersion. The previously parked Dispersion Alpha family is neither completed nor modified.

registry.policy: A future Stage-A runner must validate a runner-bound CY-059 public contract and require exact central installation before any source path is stated, resolved, hashed or opened.

v36_outcome_blind_representation_control.access: Exact signal-date/symbol overlap and price_delay_52w_4l column only; no V36 outcome or chart artifact.

source_and_time_boundary.decision_schedule: Last completed A-share market session of each calendar month.
source_and_time_boundary.decision_at: Completed signal-session close after that session's registered row is available.
source_and_time_boundary.formation_window: The exact latest 120 consecutive global market sessions ending at and including the signal session; an additional exact 20-session causal prefix is required to form the first RV20 observation and its first innovation.

eligible_history.boards: Historical Main Board and ChiNext identities 600/601/603/605.SH and 000/001/002/300/301.SZ.
eligible_history.base_row_requirements: For every target and peer row require hard_valid, bar_valid, trading_state_valid, corporate_action_valid, nonblocking corporate action, market_valid, market_rule_valid, historical_identity_valid, available_at<=decision_at, all registered snapshot IDs nonblank, finite positive OHLC/preclose, coherent OHLC and finite action-safe log(close/preclose). Missing or invalid formation rows fail the target-date representation closed.
eligible_history.market_return: For every stock and global session use the exact leave-one-out median action-safe daily log return among at least 500 other then-eligible historical Main/ChiNext stocks. Peer membership is rebuilt causally on each date.
eligible_history.signal_row_requirements: At t require non-ST, trade_status=1, current_day_data_tradable, valid nonblank PIT industry, float_valid, every base validity gate, positive finite amount, turnover_fraction and circulating_shares, and available_at<=decision_at.
eligible_history.amount_floor: Current amount must be at least the same-date median among otherwise eligible signal rows; amount never enters the exposure score.
eligible_history.snapshot_semantics: Every historical row must carry nonblank registered snapshot identities. Snapshot IDs prove row provenance and are not required to be equal across dates.

canonical_representation.market_realized_volatility: For target i and day t, RV20_-i,t = sqrt(sum over s=t-19..t of M_-i,s squared), using the causal leave-one-out market-return series and exactly 20 consecutive global sessions.
canonical_representation.aggregate_volatility_innovation: NU_-i,t = log(RV20_-i,t) - log(RV20_-i,t-1). Both RV values must be finite and strictly positive; no zero replacement, clipping or smoothing is permitted.
canonical_representation.regression_window: Exactly 120 consecutive response sessions ending at the signal close.
canonical_representation.regression: OLS r_i,t = alpha_i + beta_mkt_i*M_-i,t + beta_vol_i*NU_-i,t + epsilon_i,t over the exact 120-session response window.
canonical_representation.score: NEGATIVE_AGGREGATE_VOLATILITY_INNOVATION_BETA_120 = -beta_vol_i. Higher score means a more negative signed return exposure to an increase in aggregate volatility.
canonical_representation.numeric_fail_closed: The 120 by 3 design must have full column rank; response and both regressors must be finite; each regressor must have strictly positive centered sum of squares; coefficients must be finite. Any failure is null, never imputed, winsorized, clipped, regularized or sign-flipped.
canonical_representation.interpretation_limit: The statistic is an exposure representation under a robust broad-market proxy. It does not prove a priced volatility-risk factor, tradable hedge, option-implied variance premium or causal investor preference.

neighboring_definition_stability.purpose: Representation stability only; neighbors may not replace the canonical 120-session score or select outcomes.
neighbors: the identical regression over the latest 100 complete response sessions
the identical regression over the latest 140 complete response sessions
neighboring_definition_stability.test: Within the common eligible panel, calculate same-date and same-date-within-PIT-industry Spearman correlations of the canonical score with each neighbor.
neighboring_definition_stability.gate: Both neighbors must have median same-date and median within-industry Spearman at least +0.50 with the canonical score. Failure closes the exact family before candidate payoff or charts.

candidate_contract.industry_support: At least 12 amount-eligible complete canonical representations in the same current PIT industry and decision date.
candidate_contract.selection: Within each supported current PIT industry/date, retain exactly the stock with maximum frozen score (most negative beta_vol); break ties by larger current amount then lexical symbol.
candidate_contract.cooldown: After ranking, retain a repeated symbol only when its global signal calendar index is strictly more than 60 sessions after its last retained V37 event.

controls: ordinary 120-session contemporaneous market beta from the canonical regression
120-session market-down-day beta using the same causal market return and at least 30 negative-market observations
60-session idiosyncratic volatility against the causal leave-one-out market return
60-session volatility of the stock's own fixed RV5 path using the existing Cycle-009 formula
exact V36 price_delay_52w_4l on signal-date/symbol overlaps
outcome_blind_redundancy_controls.test: Report median same-date and median same-date-within-PIT-industry Spearman between the V37 score and every control, including row/date/group support. V36 overlap is evaluated only where the frozen representation already exists.
outcome_blind_redundancy_controls.failure: If either supported median absolute correlation is at least 0.80 for any control, or a non-V36 control lacks eight supported dates, close V37 before outcomes. V36 is reported as a bounded overlap diagnostic and cannot alone fail coverage when its calendar does not overlap.

stage_a_gates.failure_policy: If input/PIT/semantic checks fail, publish nothing. If only representation, opportunity, neighboring-stability or redundancy gates fail, atomically publish compact outcome-blind result.json, permanently close this exact family and do not inspect outcomes, charts, alternate signs, windows or thresholds.

allowed: construct exact causal leave-one-out market returns, RV20 innovations, signed exposure representations, fixed neighbors, candidates and outcome-blind controls
report coverage, dates, industries, regression rejection reasons, opportunity counts, stability and redundancy correlations
write representation_panel.parquet and candidates_frozen.parquet only if every Stage-A gate passes
forbidden: any row after a signal used as that signal's predictor
any future return, target, fill, MFE, MAE, outcome bucket, chart label, strategy result or portfolio artifact
alternate volatility estimator, innovation transformation, regression window, direction, schedule, market proxy, industry threshold or cooldown
winsorization, clipping, beta sign reversal, favorable-subset selection, Stage B, charts, portfolio replay or later-period validation

output_contract.publication: Build in a same-parent temporary directory, reverify public contract, registry installation and every source hash, then atomically rename without overwrite.

later_stage_boundary.passing_stage_a_meaning: Representation quality, opportunity breadth, neighboring-definition stability and non-obvious-redundancy readiness only; never strategy usefulness.
